svg.aria-label: screen figure; Screen the intake; Intercept large debris before treatment.
svg.title: Screen the intake

svg.aria-label: vessel figure, half; Gather and settle; Gather fine particles into floc that can settle.
svg.title: Gather and settle

svg.aria-label: vessel figure, half; Apply disinfection; Apply the selected, controlled disinfection barrier.
svg.title: Apply disinfection

svg.aria-label: layered-bed figure, full; Filter the water; Pass clarified water through filter media.
svg.title: Filter the water

svg.aria-label: vessel figure, full; Protect distribution; Protect treated water in storage and the network.
svg.title: Protect distribution

svg.aria-label: One barrier is not enough; Each stage addresses a different part of the source-water risk.; The source determines the necessary barriers and operating limits.
svg.title: One barrier is not enough

svg.aria-label: gauge figure, half; Check performance; Samples and instruments check filtration and disinfection.; Dashed arrows = monitoring, not water transport.
svg.title: Check performance

svg.aria-label: Separate residuals; Settled solids and filter wash water require separate handling.
svg.title: Separate residuals

svg.aria-label: Record and adjust; Log every check and its result.; Adjust the barrier before the next run.
svg.title: Record and adjust

g.text: Log every check and its result.

svg.aria-label: How to read this diagram; Solid arrows carry water.; Dashed arrows carry checks and residuals.; Numbers follow the barriers in order.
svg.title: How to read this diagram
